lines.text: Halfway up the ridge, Nora's bottle was empty.
The creek beside her looked crystal clear, so she knelt to drink.
Clear water can still carry bacteria and parasites you can't see.
Carry a filter straw, drink through it, or fill your bottle and filter as you go.
Choose flowing water away from trails and campsites.
Nora drank, and the hike went on.
Save this before your next long hike.
